title: Official: Bad Bunny to Close World Tour With Two "Cerramos en Casa" Shows at Hiram Bithorn, Aug 22–23
detail: Bad Bunny and Rimas Entertainment officially confirm two homecoming concerts at Estadio Hiram Bithorn in San Juan on August 22 and 23, 2026, billed as "Debí Tirar Más Fotos – Cerramos en Casa" ("We Close at Home"). Promoters Move Concerts and Noah Assad Presents announced the dates via social media with an image showing the tour's stops, the recurring plastic-chair stage motif, and the Puerto Rican flag, ending weeks of speculation fueled by stadium construction and sponsor teasers (T-Mobile, Medalla Light, CeraVe). Tickets go on sale Wednesday, August 19 at 10:00 a.m. local time exclusively through PRticket.com, with a Banco Popular cardholder presale also opening August 19; a virtual queue opens August 18 via Bad Bunny's official site. Prices range $50–$100 per ticket before fees, one transaction per card, four-ticket max, all sales online-only and final. The shows close the 55-date Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour — which technically concluded July 22 in Brussels — with a homecoming coda in the country where it launched via the sold-out Coliseo residency.
